findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed in use mop to be resting directly on floor. Discussed with PIC, mop was moved to mop ringer. Ensure after use mop is stored in a way that prevents contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment: Observed multiple bowls and plates to not be inverted near dish machine area. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and plates were inverted. Ensure any cleaned equipment or utensils are properly stored to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(B) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (B) Clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS shall be stored as specified under (A) of this section and shall be stored: (1) In a self-draining position that allows air drying; and (2) Covered or inverted.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed food debris accumulation to be present on top of dish machine. Discussed with PIC, dish machine will be cleaned. Ensure facility is cleaning dish machine at a frequency that prevents any accumulation from building.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Observed a leak to be present at the triple sink faucet. Discussed with PIC, faucet will be serviced. Ensure a licensed plumber is contacted to service faucet so no leaks are present within facility.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: Observed floor drain in between triple sink and hand sink to be blocked and starting to overflow. Discussed with PIC, a work order has been placed. Maintenance was contacted and it was determined the hand sink and triple sink basin were the reason floor drain is overflowing. Both sinks will not be used until drain is serviced. Inspector will follow up with facility on 4/24/26.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed caulking to be missing at mop sink. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure facility is monitoring/replacing caulking as needed.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
